name: Guesty
summary: Property management for short-term and vacation rentals: bookings, guest messaging, channel distribution and pricing in one dashboard. Heavy for a single listing.
best_for: hosts with 1-3 listings starting on Guesty Lite (~$9/mo + ~1% per reservation) who may grow into the full property-management platform
skip_if: you want quote-free scaling — Pro and Enterprise are custom-priced, so growth means a sales conversation
honest_knock: Pricing runs higher than leaner rivals, onboarding has a learning curve, and some users flag support — it earns its keep at scale, but it's heavy for a single listing.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-22 against the vendor's own pricing page and the Guesty Lite package page, read from a Dutch exit) Guesty Lite is $9/mo PER LISTING plus 1% per reservation in 34 named markets, for 1-3 listings; Pro covers 4-199 listings and Enterprise 200+, both quote-only. 14-day free trial of Lite, no credit card. NOTHING CHANGED in the geo table since 31 Aug 2026, value for value. READING NOTE: guesty.com/pricing shows no price at all in the served HTML -- the plan-price divs are empty and are filled in the browser from a geoPricing payload. That payload: a 34-country group (US, GB, AU, NZ, CA, MX, BE, CR, HR, DK, HU, IS, IE, JP, PH, SI, ZA, SE, TH, AR, PE, CO, CY, MT, VI, KY, AT, DE, BR, GR, IL, IT, ES, FR) at $9 annual AND $9 monthly, note '+1% per reservation | Including PriceOptimizer'; group2 (SA, KR, CZ) $20/$29; group3 (SK, RO, BG) $18/$26; group4 (LV, LT, EE, TR, SV, GT, HN, NI, PA, BO, CL, EC, GY, PY, SR, UY, VE, ID, MY, KH, LA, VN, IN, BZ) $16/$23; group1 $24/$34 with an EMPTY country list, so no country is priced into it; fallback for every unlisted country $27 annual / $39 monthly, and that fallback is the only entry carrying a sale tag ('Save 30%!'). The Netherlands is not named; Belgium is. SECOND, DIFFERENT PRICE SET on the same domain: guesty.com/packages/guesty-lite/ shows three static Lite cards -- 'Pay as you grow' from $9/mo per listing with 'Per listing + 1% per reservation' and PriceOptimizer included; 'Annual' from $20/mo per listing, tagline 'Save up to <s>30%</s> 50%' with a 'Limited time offer' flag; 'Monthly' from $29/mo per listing, '100% Flexibility'. Only the $9 card carries a percentage line. VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION, confirm before relying: the geo note reads '+1% per reservation | Including PriceOptimizer' while the feature table on the same page lists Guesty PriceOptimizer as an 'Add-on' on Lite, Pro and Enterprise alike; and the FAQ says 'The monthly plan is not discounted, so if you are looking to save, we recommend the annual plan' while the $9 group pays the same number either way. Add-ons rather than inclusions on Pro: Trust Accounting, GuestyPay, Fraud & Chargeback Management, GuestVerify, Damage Protection, Liability Coverage. Lite excludes owner management and the owners portal, rate strategies and promotions, phone support and a dedicated CSM, and processes payments through Stripe only. Also on the pricing page: a Guesty Ultimate bundle advertised at 'Save 40%' with 25% off Damage Protection and 25% off Guest Communication Services. Vendor's own numbers on the Lite page: hosts 'increase their revenue by an average of +28.5% in their first year', 500K+ listings managed.
